test_title: PYST 33 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 25 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Change the following sentence into the Active form.

The decision was made at the meeting.

options.text: Someone made the decision at the meeting.
The decision is made at the meeting.
Someone makes the decision at the meeting.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The original sentence is in the passive voice: "The decision was made at the meeting."
 
• In the active voice, the subject performing the action is clearly stated, and the sentence structure changes accordingly.
 
• To convert this sentence into active voice, we identify the implied subject, which is "Someone."
